values.note: 2026 camping rates, all water and electric sites: 30-amp $30 a night ($170 a week, $650 a month), 50-amp $35 ($200 / $700). Holiday weekend special (Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day): three nights for $75. Camp Meeting special (July 28 - Aug 7): $160 for 30 amp, $210 for 50 amp. 'Rates are subject to change without notice.'

fees.source: https://www.stlouiscampground.org/rates ('2026 Camping Rates ... 30 AMP SITES: $30.00 per night ... 50 AMP SITES: $35.00 per night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: '120+' campsites (the home page says '150+ camping lots'), all with water and electric; grassy sites.

sites.source: https://www.stlouiscampground.org/about ('The St. Louis Campground offers 120+ campsites with both water and electric hookups') + https://www.stlouiscampground.org/ ('150+ camping lots'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Two bath houses, one at each end, with showers, toilets and a family bathroom. Dump station free for registered campers ($15 otherwise).

facilities.source: https://www.stlouiscampground.org/about ('two large bath houses ... both equipped with showers, toilets, handicap facilities and a family shower/bathroom') + https://www.stlouiscampground.org/policies ('The RV dump station may be used free of charge by registered campers only'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Open May 1st through October, weather permitting.

season.source: https://www.stlouiscampground.org/about-3 ('We are open May 1st through October (weather permitting)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations by phone, (989) 681-2581. Open to the public all season, including the Church of God camp meeting in early August (2026: July 30 - August 7; 2027: July 29 - August 1). Gates locked midnight to 8 am.

booking.source: https://www.stlouiscampground.org/about ('Call us today for more information or to make a reservation!'; 'The St. Louis campground is open to the public, even during the first week of August, when we still honor the tradition that is the St. Louis Camp Meeting') + https://www.stlouiscampground.org/camp-meeting + https://www.stlouiscampground.org/policies, read 2026-10-22

note: Church of God (Anderson, IN)-affiliated campground, home of the St. Louis Camp Meeting since 1883, open to the public for nightly RV camping; cabins, dorms and a duplex also rentable, plus pavilions, tabernacles and a prayer garden. Alcohol and tobacco prohibited on the grounds. --Claude
summary: Operator's pages: 2026 rates $30 (30-amp) / $35 (50-amp), weekly and monthly too; 120+ sites all with water and 30/50-amp electric; showers, toilets, free dump; open May 1 through October; reservations by phone (989) 681-2581 (matches). Confirmed open to the public even during camp-meeting week (does not close for church events). Fees, hookups, booking platform confirmed; added site count, facilities, season dates, booking note. Max rig 40 ft (derived) not stated on the pages; left. Google Maps: 4.9 stars / 92 reviews. No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed here. Note cleaned of price/site/season/booking text.
